rationale: The response treats the allegation as absurd, reframes the plural 'holidays' as more American, and maintains an indignant sworn-testimony register throughout, directly addressing the Chair.
quote: When I used the plural "holidays," I was not invoking some generalized, calendar-blurring winter sentiment! I was not attempting to wage a war on the Fourth of July! No, sirs! I was referring to the sacred, God-given, three-day American summer pantheon!
